title: My Dad Said My Games Burned a Ghost Into Our TV #shorts

cast.dad: a stick-figure father with a round white head, dot eyes, thin black limbs, a short black beard, square glasses and a green sweater
cast.kid: a stick-figure boy with a round white head, dot eyes, thin black limbs, curly black hair and a red hoodie

lines.text: Dad said my games burned a ghost into our TV, so who really burned it?
lines.label: hook
lines.headline: who burned the ghost
lines.image: {kid} is the only person in the picture, standing in a dim living room pointing at exactly one big flat TV with a faint gray ghostly shape on its dark screen, worried face, evening

lines.text: One morning, a faint gray shape was stuck on our TV, no matter what played.
lines.label: problem
lines.headline: a shape that stays
lines.image: {kid} is the only person in the picture, kneeling close to exactly one big flat TV, the only screen in the room, in a sunny morning living room, squinting at a faint gray smudge on its bright screen

lines.text: Dad said, "I just doze off watching shows, buddy, and shows can't hurt a TV."
lines.label: the charge
lines.headline: dad dozes, blames game
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, slumped sleepily on a living room couch in front of exactly one big flat TV, droopy half-closed eyes, mouth open mid-sentence talking, a cozy dim evening living room

lines.text: He locked my console in the garage for a month so the TV could heal.
lines.label: stakes
lines.headline: console locked away
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, putting exactly one game console into exactly one cardboard box on a high garage shelf, stern face, a dim garage

lines.text: A week later, with zero games played, the ghost on the screen got even darker.
lines.label: worse
lines.headline: the ghost gets darker
lines.image: {kid} is the only person in the picture, standing in a living room staring at exactly one big flat TV whose dark gray ghostly shape is now clearly darker, shocked face

lines.text: Dad said I must be sneaking games at night, so he took my phone too.
lines.label: more blame
lines.headline: phone gone too
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, standing in a hallway holding exactly one phone up high out of reach, frowning, evening light

lines.text: I sat alone on the stairs, blamed for a gray ghost I never even made.
lines.label: alone
lines.headline: blamed for nothing
lines.image: close-up of {kid} sitting alone on a staircase, hugging his knees, sad eyes looking down, a single tear on his cheek, dim hallway light

lines.text: My science teacher said pictures left frozen for hours, night after night, can burn in.
lines.label: the fact
lines.headline: frozen pictures burn in
lines.image: {kid} is the only person in the picture, sitting at a classroom desk with eyes wide in surprise, a chalkboard behind him with a drawing of a TV and a clock

lines.text: So I filled the whole screen with plain red, and the ghost lit up clear.
lines.label: the test
lines.headline: the red screen test
lines.image: {kid} is the only person in the picture, holding exactly one TV remote toward exactly one big flat TV whose whole screen is plain solid bright red, with only a faint pale gray stripe along the bottom edge and a small pale gray square in one top corner, no face and no picture on the screen, determined face

lines.text: My game's health bar sits at the top, but this ghost ran along the bottom.
lines.label: gamer clue
lines.headline: wrong spot for my game
lines.image: {kid} is the only person in the picture, standing beside exactly one big flat TV whose whole screen is plain solid bright red, pointing a finger at a faint pale gray stripe along the very bottom edge of the red screen, the rest of the screen empty plain red, thinking hard

lines.text: I showed Dad: his news channel's logo and headline bar, burned in by sleepy nights.
lines.label: the twist
lines.headline: it was dad's news
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, frozen in shock with mouth wide open, standing in front of exactly one big red-glowing TV showing a faint ghostly square in the corner and a ghostly stripe along the bottom

lines.text: Console's back, and Dad still blames my games, but the red screen clearly says news.
lines.label: payoff
lines.headline: team dad or team me
lines.image: {kid} is the only person in the picture, sitting on a living room couch happily holding exactly one game controller, grinning, exactly one big TV glowing in front of him, cozy evening
